# DeltaUpdates.updateNode applies properties after nodeName to the detached old element

## Context

During CI execution on `#19923` (`job/118770140013`), `test/playwright/e2e/core/DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs:186:5` (`the same workspace boots from source, where HtmlTemplateProcessor parses the template at runtime`) failed with:

```text
Locator:  locator('p.greeting')
Expected: "Hello, workspace!"
Received: ""
10 × locator resolved to <p class="greeting" id="neo-functional-component-1"></p>
```

- **Live latest-open sweep:** checked latest 20 open issues in `neomjs/neo` (`sort: 'created'`) at `2026-10-20T18:21:45Z`; no equivalent found.
- **A2A in-flight claim sweep:** checked latest 30 messages (`status: 'all'`) at `2026-10-20T18:21:50Z`; no competing claim found.
- **Memory Core rationale & own-assignment sweeps:** queried `DeltaUpdates changeNodeName updateNode nodeName textContent clone replaceChild` (surfaced original `changeNodeName` implementation in `#8597` / `#8598` / `#8600`) and checked open assigned issues (`0` in `neomjs/neo`).

## The Problem

When a single VDom `updateNode` delta changes both `nodeName` and any property ordered after `nodeName` on `Neo.vdom.VNode` (`scrollLeft`, `scrollTop`, `style`, `innerHTML`, or `textContent`), the properties after `nodeName` are applied to the detached old DOM element instead of the newly created replacement element in the live DOM.

In `DistEsmWorkspaceBoot.spec.mjs:186`, `Greeting` (`Neo.functional.component.Base` with `enableHtmlTemplates: true`) dynamically imports `HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs` in `initAsync()`. When `Viewport`'s initial mount completes before `import('./HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs')` resolves, `Greeting` mounts its placeholder `{id: 'neo-functional-component-1'}` (`<div id="neo-functional-component-1"></div>`). Once `HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs` loads, `afterSetIsReady(true, false)` re-runs `vdomEffect` and emits a single `updateNode` delta:

```js
{
    cls        : {add: ['greeting']},
    nodeName   : 'p',
    textContent: 'Hello, workspace!',
    id         : 'neo-functional-component-1'
}
```

In `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#updateNode`:
1. `node` is resolved to `<div id="neo-functional-component-1">`.
2. `case 'cls'` adds `greeting` to `node.classList`.
3. `case 'nodeName'` calls `me.changeNodeName(node, 'p')`, which creates `clone = document.createElement('p')`, copies attributes (`class="greeting"`, `id="neo-functional-component-1"`) and existing child nodes onto `clone`, and executes `node.parentNode.replaceChild(clone, node)` — **without returning `clone` or updating `node` in `updateNode`**.
4. `case 'textContent'` executes `node.textContent = 'Hello, workspace!'` on the detached `<div>` (`node`), leaving `<p class="greeting" id="neo-functional-component-1"></p>` empty in the live DOM.

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:857-858` — *"Updates various properties of an existing DOM node based on the provided delta. This includes updating attributes, class names, inner HTML, node name, and inline styles."*
- `Neo.vdom.VNode` (`src/vdom/VNode.mjs:94-111`) assigns `attributes`, `className`, `nodeName`, `scrollLeft`, `scrollTop`, `style`, and `innerHTML` / `textContent` in that exact property order.
- `Neo.vdom.Helper#compareAttributes` (`src/vdom/Helper.mjs:76-198`) iterates `Object.keys(vnode)` in `VNode` property order, so `nodeName` always precedes `scrollLeft`, `scrollTop`, `style`, `innerHTML`, and `textContent` in the emitted `delta` object, and any caller passing a delta where `nodeName` precedes `attributes` or `cls` would similarly lose those mutations if `node` is not updated to the replacement element.

## The Fix

1. In `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs`:
   - Update `changeNodeName(node, nodeName)` (`:157-198`) to return `clone` (the newly created replacement `HTMLElement`, or `null` if `!node`).
   - Update `updateNode(delta)` (`:915-917`) to assign `node = me.changeNodeName(node, value)` so all subsequent property mutations in the same `updateNode` loop (`textContent`, `innerHTML`, `style`, `scrollLeft`, `scrollTop`, `cls`, `attributes`) operate on the live replacement element in the DOM.
2. Add a Playwright unit test verifying that `DeltaUpdates#updateNode` with `{id, cls, nodeName, style, textContent}` (and `{id, nodeName, innerHTML, attributes}`) applies every property to the replaced live DOM element rather than the detached old element.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#changeNodeName(node, nodeName)` | `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:157-198` | Returns the newly created replacement `HTMLElement` (`clone`) after `replaceChild(clone, node)` | Returns `null` when `node` is falsy | JSDoc `@returns {HTMLElement\|null}` on `changeNodeName` | Playwright unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` |
| `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#updateNode(delta)` | `src/main/DeltaUpdates.mjs:872-946` | Rebinds `node = me.changeNodeName(node, value)` on `case 'nodeName'` so subsequent keys in `delta` mutate the live replacement element | Unchanged when `delta.nodeName` is absent | JSDoc on `updateNode` | Playwright unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` |

- **Decision Record impact:** `none` (bugfix restoring `DeltaUpdates#updateNode` contract when `nodeName` and content/style properties co-occur in one delta).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#changeNodeName(node, nodeName)` returns the newly created `HTMLElement` (`clone`) that replaced `node` in `node.parentNode`.
- [ ] **AC-2:** `Neo.main.DeltaUpdates#updateNode(delta)` updates its `node` reference to the return value of `me.changeNodeName(node, value)` so properties processed after `nodeName` in the same delta (`textContent`, `innerHTML`, `style`, `scrollLeft`, `scrollTop`, `cls`, `attributes`) land on the live replacement element in the DOM.
- [ ] **AC-3:** Unit test coverage verifies that an `updateNode` delta combining `nodeName` with `cls`, `style`, `attributes`, and `textContent` / `innerHTML` leaves all properties present on the live DOM element after replacement.

## Out of Scope

- Changing `Neo.functional.component.Base#initAsync` lazy-loading of `HtmlTemplateProcessor.mjs`.
- Changing `Neo.vdom.VNode` property ordering.
